The framework distinguishes four dimensions of independence: framing, evidence, mechanism, and authority. It also formalizes a four-function review architecture consisting of a producer, challenger, evidence checker, and acceptance owner.\\n</div>\\n<div>\\n <br>\\n</div>\\n<div>\\n The framework is positioned relative to research on LLM self-correction, chain-of-verification, multi-agent debate, LLM-as-a-judge, correlated model errors, and emerging agentic verification systems.
